rules.summary: Authored files have at most 200 physical lines.
Authored files have at most 32768 UTF-8 bytes.
Ordinary authored lines have at most 120 Unicode scalars.
Tracked immediate directory entries have at most 16 members.
Tracked depth greater than 8 is discouraged.
Tracked depth greater than 12 is forbidden.
One-child directories require review.
Tracked symbolic links are forbidden.
Tracked paths must be regular UTF-8 files.
Conservatively detected packed Rust statements are forbidden.
Authored minified JSON is forbidden.
Giant base64-like authored literals are forbidden.
Giant compressed or hidden-source-like literals are forbidden.
Conservative Rust top-level item counts over 16 require review.
Conservative Rust import or module fanout over 16 requires review.
Exact-path provenance hashes must match.
Provenance uses exact paths without glob syntax.
Provenance classifications are closed.
Capsule dependencies must be acyclic.
Capsules use the closed lkjscript.capsule v1 contract.
Capsule IDs are unique.
Actual internal crate dependencies must be capsule-declared.
Declared capsule dependencies resolve exactly.
Capsule dependency fanout is at most 16.
Audit reads remain within the fixed input bound.
Each exact provenance path occurs once.
Mutable generated files identify their generator.
Every provenance path is tracked.
Provenance inputs remain readable within the repository.
Repository revision and file sizes remain stable during audit.
Ratchet records must describe current violations.
